verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no automations feature in Lovable, so it also documents no way to version, review, or roll back automations. Git sync, pull-request review, file diffs and edit history all concern project application code; that is a different capability and earns no credit here. Rollback is not documented anywhere in the pack, even for projects.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
